notes.title: Update 28.02
notes.notes:
In this update, we continue to focus on addressing the aspects that were considered least predominant by the majority.

List of major changes:

 Graphics. The game has undergone many visible graphical improvements. The visual elements are now even more realistic.
 Narrative. The format and sequence of the storyline have been changed for greater clarity.
 Settings. Now, settings that were previously only available for changes in the menu can be adjusted at any point during the gameplay.
 Miscellaneous. The game has undergone various changes that positively impact overall optimization and player immersion.

notes.title: Update 10.01
notes.notes:
The first correctional update for "Cursed New Year", which focuses on correcting the main points that previously hindered a comfortable gameplay, as well as adding elements for greater immersion.

- Graphics. The overall game graphics have been partially changed for the better, and the location has gained more illumination due to redesigned lighting.

- Optimization.  The results of in-game tests of the updated version confirm a more efficient use of device resources compared to the previous version. This results in improved performance and smoother gameplay.

- Other. According to statistics and feedback from players, the previous version of the game had problems with the achievement system. Achievements have been adjusted in the latest update.
